verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents that private API keys carry API key scopes, including a Custom option to decide how much access to grant, which limits what third parties can access. OAuth is also offered for apps. These are first-party least-privilege credentials, but the evidence shows only part of the story for an agent. missing for 10: granular scope list (per-resource read/write), key creation/rotation/revocation workflow, explicit evidence that scoped keys or OAuth gate the MCP server or agent access, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: All `/api` endpoints use private API keys with API key scopes to authenticate requests.
Adding a scope helps you protect your and your customers’ data by limiting what third parties can access.
Custom Allows you to decide how much access to give the third party
Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs)
